ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image there is a dung beetle life cycle represented by pink circular arrows, with stages labeled A, B, C, D. Label A is located on the right side, and next to it is drawn a pale, segmented, worm-like larval form, curled in or near a dung ball; it is not an egg, nor a pupa or adult. According to the insect life cycle, the worm-like stage after the egg and before the pupa is called larva. Therefore, A represents larva.
